prompt:
Locked-off camera, no camera movement. The small woman in the canary-yellow coat stands on the bank steps facing the lens, other hand on her hip. From the first frame she raises one gloved index finger upright beside her face and wags it side to side, left, right, left, right, in a steady tick-tock on the beat, the clear universal gesture for "no", her head giving a small matching shake, mock-stern and sure of herself; on the last beat she stops the finger dead and points it straight at the lens, and holds it there. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, a loose bratty shoulder roll, never stiff. Her canary-yellow balaclava is one smooth, seamless knitted dome over her whole head and face: plain canary knit with only the white ring and the red triangle on it, the knit lying flat and still over her face the whole time.

Thanks.
